records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 8.4 percent in the first quarter of 2021 compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in revenue per shipment and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 89.9 percent in the first quarter of 2021 compared to 91.3 percent in the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The improved operating ratio compared to prior year is due to the Company’s continued focus on pricing initiatives, cost control and operational efficiencies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $48.7 million for the first quarter of 2021 compared to $38.8 million for the first quarter of 2020.
